plausible_root_causes: rate series not kept in date order when a late correction is added

constraints.C1: lookups are independent of insertion order
constraints.C2: a same-date rate replaces the earlier one, in any order
constraints.C3: history() is chronological with one rate per date; files store rates oldest first
constraints.C4: inverse and triangulated lookups follow out-of-order corrections
constraints.C5: the provider rate file with a late correction, end to end
